hooks.name: restore-working-memory
hooks.description: At session start, print the on-disk task state into context: goal, constraints, open acceptance criteria, recent decisions, next action. This is what lets a new or post-compaction session resume without re-deriving anything. Command actions consume no credits, and stdout from SessionStart is added to context.

hooks.name: snapshot-working-memory
hooks.description: When the agent finishes responding, re-render .kiro/.memory/TASK.md so the human-readable snapshot is always current. Side effect only; Stop hook stdout is not added to context.

hooks.name: validate-kiro-config-on-save
hooks.description: Validate a skill or steering file immediately after it is saved. A non-zero exit surfaces the problem as a warning, which catches the silent failure mode where a malformed SKILL.md or an invalid inclusion mode means the file never loads at all.

hooks.name: block-secret-commits
hooks.description: Scan staged content for credential patterns before a git commit runs. Exit 2 blocks the tool call and returns stderr to the agent. Disabled by default because the matcher fires on every shell call and the pattern set needs tuning per repo; enable it deliberately.

action.command: if git diff --cached 2>/dev/null | grep -qEi '(api[_-]?key|secret|password|private[_-]key)["'\'' ]*[:=]|BEGIN [A-Z ]*PRIVATE KEY|AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}|sk-[a-zA-Z0-9]{20,}|ghp_[a-zA-Z0-9]{20,}'; then echo 'Blocked: staged changes appear to contain a credential. Unstage it, and rotate the secret if it was ever committed.' >&2; exit 2; fi
